MotionScope.description: Sets the motion personality for everything inside: CSS springs via [data-sg-motion], JS springs and portals via context. This is the one way to give part of an app, or a single component, its own personality; components take no motion prop. The wrapper is display: contents but still a DOM parent, so put it around a whole group (a ButtonGroup, a TabBar), not around one of its children. Without `motion` it inherits, keeping the same element so toggling the override never remounts what is inside.
